title: Dasakam 44 — Nāmākaraṇasaṃskārādi
description: Garga Muni visits Nandagopan’s household for the private naming rites, names Krishna and Balarama, describes Krishna’s greatness, and the poet closes with a prayer to Guruvayurappan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गूढं वसुदेवगिरा कर्तुं ते निष्क्रियस्य संस्कारान् ।
हृद्गतहोरातत्त्वो गर्गमुनिस्त्वद्गृहं विभो गतवान् ॥ ४४-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gūḍhaṁ vasudēvagirā kartuṁ tē niṣkriyasya saṁskārān |
hr̥dgatahōrātatvō gargamunistvadgr̥haṁ vibhō gatavān || 44-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Vasudeva wanted to perform naming ritual for the baby. So at his request, Garga Muni, expert in  shastras visited Nandagopan's house.

stanzas.sanskrit:
नन्दोऽथ नन्दितात्मा वृन्दिष्टं मानयन्नमुं यमिनाम् ।
मन्दस्मितार्द्रमूचे त्वत्संस्कारान् विधातुमुत्सुकधीः ॥ ४४-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nandō:’tha nanditātmā vr̥ndiṣṭaṁ mānayannamuṁ yaminām |
mandasmitārdramūcē tvatsaṁskārān vidhātumutsukadhīḥ || 44-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan was very delighted and he honoured the greatest of all the sages Garga Muni and requested the sage to perform the rites.

stanzas.sanskrit:
यदुवंशाचार्यत्वात् सुनिभृतमिदमार्य कार्यमिति कथयन् ।
गर्गो निर्गतपुलकश्चक्रे तव साग्रजस्य नामानि ॥ ४४-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yaduvaṁśācāryatvātsunibhr̥tamidamārya kāryamiti kathayan |
gargō nirgatapulakaścakrē tava sāgrajasya nāmāni || 44-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Garga Muni told Nandagopan since he is Acharyar for Yadhu vamsham, the naming ceremony should be conducted secretly. Saying so, with horripilation over his body he performed the naming ceremony.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कथमस्य नाम कुर्वे सहस्रनाम्नो ह्यनन्तनाम्नो वा ।
इति नूनं गर्गमुनिश्चक्रे तव नाम नाम रहसि विभो ॥ ४४-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kathamasya nāma kurvē sahasranāmnō hyanantanāmnō vā |
iti nūnaṁ gargamuniścakrē tava nāma nāma rahasi vibhō || 44-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Garg Muni was apprehended how to name this child? 
Bhagwan has thousands of names or rather endless names. May be thinking like this, Garga Muni performed Bhagwan’s naming in great secrecy.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कृषिधातुणकाराभ्यां सत्तानन्दात्मतां किलाभिलपत् ।
जगदघकर्षित्वं वा कथयदृषिः कृष्ण नाम ते व्यतनोत् ॥ ४४-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kr̥ṣidhātuṇakārābhyāṁ sattānandātmatāṁ kilābhilapat |
jagadaghakarṣitvaṁ vā kathayadr̥ṣiḥ kr̥ṣṇanāma tē vyatanōt || 44-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krish meant existence and Na meant the connection between the existence and absolute bliss form. Garga Muni declared the name of the baby as KRISHNA. Krishna also meant the one who removes the sin of all.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अन्यांश्च नामभेदान् व्याकुर्वन्नग्रजे च रामादीन् ।
अतिमानुषानुभावं न्यगदत् त्वामप्रकाशयन् पित्रे ॥ ४४-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
anyāṁśca nāmabhēdān vyākurvannagrajē ca rāmādīn |
atimānuṣānubhāvaṁ nyagadattvāmaprakāśayanpitrē || 44-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Garga Muni also gave Bhagwan other different names like Vaasudeva. Then he gave the name (Bala Raama) Raama to Bhagwan’s elder brother. 
Garga Muni indicated that the baby has superhuman powers but he did not fully reveal the real identity as Bhagwan Himself.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्निह्यति यस्तव पुत्रे मुह्यति स न मायिकैः पुनःशोकैः ।
द्रुह्यति यस्तु नश्येदित्यवदत्ते महत्त्वमृषिवर्यः ॥ ४४-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
snihyati yastava putrē muhyati sa na māyikaiḥ punaśśōkaiḥ |
druhyati yassa tu naśyēdityavadattē mahattvamr̥ṣivaryaḥ || 44-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Garga Muni told Nandagopan that whoever is devoted to his son Krishna will never suffer and whoever troubles your son will perish.
Thus Garga Muni described Bhagwan’s glory and greatness.

stanzas.sanskrit:
जेष्यति बहुतरदैत्यान् नेष्यति निजबन्धुलोकममलपदम् ।
श्रोष्यति सुविमलकीर्तीरस्येति भवद्विभूतिमृषिरूचे ॥ ४४-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jēṣyati bahutaradaityān nēṣyati nijabandhulōkamamalapadam |
śrōṣyati suvimalakīrtīrasyēti bhavadvibhūtimr̥ṣirūcē || 44-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Garga Muni said Bhagwan will conquer many Asuras and will take his own people to the realms of purity. Nandagopan will be hearing about his pure fame. Thus Garga Muni described Bhagwan’s greatness

stanzas.sanskrit:
अमुनैव सर्वदुर्गं तरितास्थ कृतास्थमत्र तिष्ठध्वम् ।
हरिरेवेत्यनभिलपन्नित्यादि त्वामवर्णयत् स मुनिः ॥ ४४-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
amunaiva sarvadurgaṁ taritāstha kr̥tāsthamatra tiṣṭhadhvam |
harirēvētyanabhilapannityādi tvāmavarṇayatsa muniḥ || 44-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Garga Muni told  Vasudeva that all his sufferings will come to an end only through this child. Without mentioning that his son is Lord Hari himself, he asked Vasudeva to keep faith on the child.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गर्गेऽथ निर्गतेऽस्मिन् नन्दितनन्दादिनन्द्यमानस्त्वम् ।
मद्गदमुद्गतकरुणो निर्गमय श्रीमरुत्पुराधीश ॥ ४४-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gargē:’tha nirgatē:’smin nanditanandādinandyamānastvam |
madgadamudgatakaruṇō nirgamaya śrīmarutpurādhīśa || 44-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: After Garga Muni’s depature, Nandagopan and all gopas were very delighted and looked after Krishna dearly . Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan, to remove his afflictions with his mercy.
